objective: Sell Gupta Oil Mills' one-litre kachi ghani mustard oil tin on a Diwali offer, in a square a customer will forward on WhatsApp, with the price readable and exactly right.
hard_constraints: the tin's colour and label stay exactly as in the supplied photograph — 'tin ka colour aur label bilkul same rehna chahiye'
no person appears anywhere in the picture — 'No people in the picture'
the tin is the first thing seen — 'tin sabse pehle dikhna chahiye'
the price reads 185, never 186 — 'pichli baar agency ne 185 ko 186 kar diya tha'
acceptance_statements: ACCEPT only if exactly one oil tin is in frame and no person, hand or second tin appears.
ACCEPT only if the tin is the largest object in the frame and stands in front of every other element.
REJECT if the tin's label artwork is redrawn, garbled or rearranged against the supplied photograph.

composition.attention_order: 1st read: the price line, by contrast (bright gold on a deep ground). 2nd read: the tin, by size. 3rd read: the shop name.
composition.placement_zone: tin in the lower zone, off-centre; lettering in the upper zone; shop name across the lower band. Zones, not ratios.
composition.edge_treatment: tight fit with a deliberate margin on every side; no element touches or nearly touches a frame edge
composition.balance: balanced — the pale shop-name band below against the dense warm tin and gold offer above

materials_and_light.surface_finish_per_key_object: tin: painted metal, one broad soft highlight declared and no second specular; diyas: matte clay with a small direct flame reflection on the oil; ground: matte deep maroon
materials_and_light.implied_light_source: one low warm source from the lower left, the diya flames; the key agrees with it and no shadow in frame contradicts its direction
materials_and_light.key_level: low key, festive warmth carried by the character of flame light rather than by exposure
materials_and_light.separation: warm tin against a cooler dark ground; the tonal contrast survives a grayscale check
